## Held back
Two stock-photo images (`hawk.jpg` and `cathay.jpg`) are deliberately NOT fixtures. Their file names look like stock-photo ids and their source is
unconfirmed, so they are **held back** (not distributed) and no test depends on them. Any parity result obtained on them locally is not a committed claim.

`reference_hashes.json` holds the reference stroke hashes generated by running the frozen prototype script `scripts/recipe_frozen.py` (read-only; its own sha256 is
recorded in that file) on exactly these three files, at the default 257x182 page and the legacy 257x176 page. `make_fixtures.py` regenerates the inputs and
the hashes; it writes only inside this folder and deletes its scratch dirs afterwards.
